title: EG&G as gatekeeper of Area 51
place_text: Area 51 / Groom Lake, Nevada; Las Vegas

tellings.quote: Area 51. In the early 1960s, EGNG's special projects division based in Las Vegas had been trusted to handle personnel screening, site access, transportation, and daily operations.

plain: In the early 1960s, the story goes, a contractor called EG&G, through its special projects division in Las Vegas, was trusted to run the day-to-day business of Area 51, the secret base at Groom Lake in the Nevada desert: screening staff, controlling who got in, moving people there and handling daily operations. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. If true, a private company stood as gatekeeper to one of the most secret sites in the country.
